_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O kele na kuzana Klondike Solitaire. Kimuntu kiyako kele kupindula maboko yonso na ndako ya mfunu.

Mvutu ya Mbanza:
- Ndako ya mfunu (F1-F4): Kuzenga kutoka Ace tii King na mvuala
- Ndako ya kuboko (T1-T7): Kuzenga kusuka mvuala ya kusukama (mvuala nyama na mvuala ndombe, mvuala ndombe na mvuala nyama)
- Mvuala ya maboko: Pindula maboko na ndako ya kusukama
- Ndako ya kusukama (W): Maboko ya juu kele ya kuzana

Mawete:
- 'draw' - Pindula maboko kutoka mvuala ya maboko na ndako ya kusukama
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Pindula maboko kati ya ndako
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count kele pia 'all', ambayo kele kupindula maboko yonso ya kusukama.
- 'forfeit' - Koma mbanza ya kuzana na kubika kimeni kiyako
- Mavulu ya ndako: W (ndako ya kusukama), F1-F4 (ndako ya mfunu), T1-T7 (ndako ya kuboko)

O kele kupindula mawete mengi na mbanza moja kwa kusukama na vigula:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings pekee kele ya kupindula na ndako ya kuboko ya kusukama.
Mawete kele kupindula na utaratibu - kama moja kele kufwila, mawete ya kusalia kele kusukama.
Tumina 'forfeit' kama o kele kuzana kele ya kufwila.

format_error.no_brackets: Kisalu ya mbote kele ve. Yo fwete vanda na kati ya bibaka (parentes).
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Kisalu ya mbote ve. Kimpwanza yina kele na nsuka ']' ke konda yo"
format_error.move_needs_args: Makano ya kuweka yanahitaji chanzo na lengo. Matumizi: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'

action_result.before_failure: Bo me sala mambu {n} ya bo salaka na ntwala nde kisalu kumana.

move_result.drew: Sambulwa makáti ku mizizi ya kikole.
move_result.cannot_draw: Beto lenda baka ve ata kima mosi, sambu bima yonso ya beto kele na yo me mana.
move_result.invalid_pile: Zina ya kisadilu kele mbote ve. Sadila W, F1-F4, to T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Yandi lenda tula kaka karte mosi na fondasio.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Bo me katula karti na bima ya kubeba mpi bo me tula yo na fondasio F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Mono lenda ve kunata karte ya bima yina kele na fondasio awa.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Sambulwa makáti ku mizizi ya mambu T{src} ku mizizi ya ntete F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Nge lenda ve kunata karte ya tableau na fondasio yina.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Ekoki kusonga kutoka na nsinga kwenda na nsinga
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Yandi lenda katula kaka karte mosi na kati ya karto yina kele ve mfunu mpi kutula yo na tableau.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Bo me katula karte na kisika ya bo vandaka kutula yo mpi bo me tula yo na tableau T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Mono lenda tula ve karte ya mono me zola na zulu ya kisika yina beto ke tulaka tablo.
move_result.no_face_up: Bo ta katula ve bakarti yina kele ya kukangula.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Sambilisanga {count} kadi(s) ku tableau T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Kibeni kuweka {count} bileti ku T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Yandi lenda katula kaka karte mosi na fondasio sambu yo kuma na tableau.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Sambulwa makáti ku mizizi ya ntete F{src} ku mizizi ya mambu T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Nge lenda tula ve karte ya fondasio na tableau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Bo lenda tula yo ve na kisika ya mvindu to bisika yina bo ke bumbaka bima.

outcome.forfeit: Mambu ya mambu yakoma. Nsongi ya mwisho: {score} makáti ku mizizi ya ntete.
outcome.won: Beno me nunga na nsaka ya Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Mambu ya mambu yakoma! O kubaka kiwango cha {max_turns} mambu. Nsongi: {score} makáti ku mizizi ya ntete.
